answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume, continuity is the binding constraint. Negotiate an interim/renewal arrangement with the incumbent, using market benchmarking and volume-term pricing to pursue the mandated reduction while avoiding an unvalidated primary-supplier transition. Verify the prior benchmark outcome and low-cost vendor onboarding record before committing, since neither record establishes current delivery capacity or whether an 18% reduction is attainable without service-risk tradeoffs.
